label: queryMemoryQuota
type: the cluster-level Query Service setting that caps memory per request, where 0 - the default - means no soft memory limit at all.
evidence: When set to `0` (the default), there is no soft memory limit.
* To set a memory quota with the REST API, see the cluster-level [queryMemoryQuota]
note: Filed under the parameter's own name because that is what both the Web Console settings screen and the REST API call it; there is no separate prose term to be tier-neutral about. An unbounded-by-default resource limit, the same shape of finding as storage:filesystem-free-space-limit and security:session-management - three protections in one round that are off or unlimited until an administrator intervenes.
